column2: * SHP to S16 Converter

column2: * Using Fred Chlanda converter utility and PG2 palette file
column3: * 使用 Fred Chlanda 的转换器工具和 PG2 调色板文件

column2: * (C) Luis Guzman - July 2004
column3: * (C) Luis Guzman - 2004 年 7 月

column2: This is a windows program to make easy converting SHP files into S16 peoples format
column3: 这是一个 Windows 程序，可方便地把 SHP 文件转换成 S16 peoples 格式

column2: as it converts all SHP files found in a folder.
column3: 因为它会转换文件夹中找到的所有 SHP 文件。

column2: So you can convert either picture map files or icons files, whatever you need.
column3: 因此你可以转换图片地图文件或图标文件，随你需要。

column2: It is a wraper tool as all the work is made by Fred Chlanda utility.
column3: 它是一个外壳工具，所有工作都由 Fred Chlanda 的工具完成。

column2: To install, just unzip the executable wherever you prefer, that's the
column3: 安装时，只需把可执行文件解压到你喜欢的任意位置，这就是

column2: only installation needed. A minimal screen resolution of 800x600 is recomended.
column3: 所需的全部安装。建议最低屏幕分辨率为 800x600。

column2: As usual it uses registry to "remember" your last settings.
column3: 和往常一样，它用注册表来「记住」你上次的设置。

column2: How to use:
column3: 使用方法：

column2: 1) Place all SHP files you want to convert on a temporary folder and run the tool.
column3: 1) 把你想要转换的所有 SHP 文件放到一个临时文件夹中，然后运行该工具。

column2: 2) Select the folder you have used, you will see all files you have copied there.
column3: 2) 选中你用过的那个文件夹，你会看到你复制过去的所有文件。

column2: 3) If Fred utility and palette is not found on selected folder, it is told and you will
column3: 3) 如果没有在选中的文件夹里找到 Fred 的工具和调色板，程序会提示你，此时你只能

column2: only create the BAT file but no convertion will be available.
column3: 生成 BAT 文件但无法完成转换。

column2: 4) Press buttons "Look Freds tool" and "Look PG2 palette" to find thei locations.
column3: 4) 按「查找 Fred 的工具」和「查找 PG2 调色板」按钮来定位它们的位置。

column2: 5) Answer YES when it ask for copying into selected folder (or do it manually)
column3: 5) 当它询问是否复制到选中的文件夹时，回答「是」（或手动复制）

column2: 6) Optionaly, set if you want to delete SHP files when finishing (not checked as default)
column3: 6) 可选：设置转换完成后是否删除 SHP 文件（默认不勾选）

column2: 7) Select "Create BAT file ONLY" radio option is provided in case you dont want to make
column3: 7) 还提供「仅生成 BAT 文件」单选项，用于你暂不想转换、

column2: convertion later or in case you want to see first what will be done.
column3: 或想先看看会做些什么的情况。

column2: By default second choice is selected. Either case the BAT file is created if you press OK
column3: 默认选中第二项。无论哪种情况，只要按「确定」就会生成 BAT 文件。

column2: And that's all.
column3: 就这么简单。

column3: 感谢 Fred Chlanda 提供的工具。
